pricingModel: Exact station tariff is displayed in the Sowatt app before charging; operators using the Sowatt platform may define individual or grouped tariffs.

headlineDirectRate.note: Official site advertises 0.54 EUR/kWh for Sowatt charging, but also documents per-station tariff visibility and operator-configurable tariffs; third-party station evidence shows differing values, so no universal overlay is permitted.

rule: Use only the tariff displayed for the exact station/EVSE in the official Sowatt app or an exact official station payment surface. Preserve all session/time/energy components. Never copy 0.54 EUR/kWh or another station's tariff to an unmatched EVSE.
